integrity: Exact analytical proof and independently runnable rational-arithmetic checks; no external independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time deterministic logistic growth, conservative bidirectional dispersal, constant nonnegative per-capita harvesting, identical intrinsic growth, positive crowding; sharp general formula requires edge-ratio cycle balance and feasible patch mortalities. No claim for stochastic reinvasion, time-dependent controls, arbitrary cost weights or disconnected and one-way networks.
title: Sharp extinction-control budgets on bidirectionally dispersing habitat networks
